ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60/40 distribution of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (cream/yellow-white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity patches occupy the lateral-distal regions of both lobes. The central region surrounding the notch and the proximal trailing edge are composed of solid low-intensity pixels. The left lobe exhibits higher frequency low-intensity mottling within its white patch compared to the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and deep penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the entire boundary. Notable high-amplitude irregular indentation (possible tissue loss) on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe. The right lobe exhibits a more uniform, fine-grained saw-tooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Complex S-curve; concave sweep originating from the median notch transitioning to convex curvature toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of small, circular low-intensity spots observed on the distal-ventral surface of the left lobe within the high-intensity region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the left fluke tip, distinct from natural serration.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish/cream tint across all high-intensity pixel regions, contrasting with the standard stark white typical of the species.
